==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. A ring has been drawn in the dirt in a clearing. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.)
Johnson and Gold Wielder are battling within the ring to determine who should defend the Cosmic Sea. (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (The Gold Trident Wielder is a flying, sparkling golden, faceless humanoid wielding a glowing, magical, golden trident.) (The Cosmic Sea resembles a colorful ocean in space populated by giant fish and Were-Fish.)
They can both fly so neither successfully rings out the other.
